import 'dart:async';

// Transport DTOs, discovery and logging are boundaries; completion bodies below are actual Patrol.
enum RunDartTestResponseResult { success, skipped, failure }
enum TestEntryStatus { success, skip, failure }
class RunDartTestRequest {
  RunDartTestRequest(this.name);
  final String name;
}
class RunDartTestResponse {
  RunDartTestResponse({required this.result, this.details});
  final RunDartTestResponseResult result;
  final String? details;
}
class TestEntry {
  TestEntry({required this.name, required this.status});
  final String name;
  final TestEntryStatus status;
}
class ErrorEntry { ErrorEntry({required String message}); }
class PatrolLog {
  final entries = <Object>[];
  void log(Object entry) => entries.add(entry);
}
class DiscoveredTest { final skip = false; }
// ACTUAL_RESULT_CLASS
class PatrolAppService {
  final _testExecutionRequested = Completer<String>();
  final _testExecutionCompleted = Completer<_TestExecutionResult>();
  final _patrolLog = PatrolLog();
  Future<String> get testExecutionRequested => _testExecutionRequested.future;
  Future<_TestExecutionResult> get testExecutionCompleted => _testExecutionCompleted.future;
  DiscoveredTest _findTest(String name) => DiscoveredTest();
// ACTUAL_COMPLETION_METHOD
// ACTUAL_RUN_METHOD
}
Future<void> main() async {
  final actual = <String>[];
  for (final flags in [(true, false), (true, true), (false, false), (false, true)]) {
    final service = PatrolAppService();
    final pending = service.runDartTest(RunDartTestRequest('existing journey'));
    await service.markDartTestAsCompleted(
      dartFileName: 'existing journey', passed: flags.$1, skipped: flags.$2, details: null);
    final response = await pending;
    actual.add(response.result.name);
    final entry = service._patrolLog.entries.whereType<TestEntry>().single;
    final expected = flags.$1 ? (flags.$2 ? TestEntryStatus.skip : TestEntryStatus.success)
        : TestEntryStatus.failure;
    if (entry.status != expected) throw StateError('Incorrect Patrol log verdict');
  }
  final result = actual.join(' ');
  if (result != 'success skipped failure failure') throw StateError(result);
  print('VERDICTS $result');
}
